cornerstone.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p268. 'six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date' - frees up ON the anniversary: 2026-03-20 + 6m = 2026-09-20 first free; last restricted 2026-09-19. Holder list consistent with the cornerstone section.

controller_6m.notes: Quote verbatim on p280. Explicit end date in the clause: 'in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its shareholdings in our Company is made in this Prospectus and ending on the date which is 6 months from the Listing Date'. The period ends ON 2026-09-20 (last restricted day); first free day is 2026-09-21. Candidate recorded the anniversary as first_free_day - corrected.

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): period ends ON the date which is 6 months from the Listing Date (2026-09-20); the stated end date is the last restricted day, so first_free_day = anniversary + 1

controller_12m.notes: Quote verbatim on p280. '(b) in the period of a further 6 months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in paragraph (a) above expires' states no explicit end date, so the default convention applies: first free on the 12-month anniversary 2027-03-20, last restricted 2027-03-19.
